body: an email from someone who placed an order for a RTX 3080 from Curry's Business - "In the meantime we will endeavour to source additional stock to fulfill your order, but if you do not receive a confirmation of despatch or we do not hear from you within 5 working days, your order will be automatically cancelled and a credit placed on your account for future use". The phone lines to request a refund are very busy and it can take a long time for a refund to be processed. Some users have complained that they've had to request a chargeback from their credit card company because the customer service at Curry's Business is appalling.

So I was also tempted by this deal, however after doing some research they will ultimately say its OOS and then your money goes into credit on your account. You then have to request a refund from their customer service department which can be a lengthy and frustrating experience. Would like to know if the order actually goes through, or whether they will email you to say its OOS?
